title: Hearty Peppery Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: A classic Turkish dish featuring tender lamb, crunchy poppy seeds, and a hint of peppery flavor, all grilled to perfection over binchotan charcoal
instructions: Preheat the binchotan charcoal grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, salt, paprika, turmeric, and black pepper
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Sprinkle the poppy seeds over the lamb kebabs, pressing gently to adhere
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired
